title: AI Lair Hermes capability profile
description: Declarative capability set for an AI agent session. The launcher validates the profile and translates it to Podman runtime flags. Profiles are data — auditable, diffable, shareable.

id.description: Machine-readable identifier matching the filename stem

description.description: What this profile allows the agent to do

network.description: internet = pasta --no-map-gw (web yes, host no). llm-gateway = internal network with nginx proxy. local-dual = podman bridge + hermes-llm internal net.

datasets.description: Mount the datasets/ directory at /workspace/data (read-only, analysis mode)

outbox.description: Mount the outbox/ directory at /workspace/outbox (read-write, results exit)

gpu.description: Request NVIDIA GPU device access (for local model inference)

type.description: cloud = OpenRouter API. local = llama.cpp backend managed by local-models.sh

local_profile.description: When type=local, the catalog model profile ID (e.g. gemma-4-e4b)
